# agentprof

> See what your AI coding agent loads and runs — and fix it.

agentprof is a Rust CLI and TUI that inspects what coding agents (Claude Code,
Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf) load and execute
in a workspace: secrets they can read, always-loaded instruction files, MCP tool
definitions per agent, skills, conflicting instructions, per-command shell
overhead, and Claude Code session cost.

Design principle: every figure is measured, never guessed. Values that have not
been measured are reported as absent, and unmeasured score categories are left
out of the score instead of earning points.

## Installation
- Script (prebuilt, SHA-256 verified): `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dautovri/agentprof/main/install.sh | bash`
- Homebrew: `brew install dautovri/tap/agentprof`
- From source: `cargo install --git https://github.com/dautovri/agentprof --locked`
  (the crates.io name `agentprof` belongs to an unrelated project)
- GitHub Action: `uses: dautovri/agentprof@v0.3.0` with `fail-under: 80`
- Repository: https://github.com/dautovri/agentprof
- Documentation: https://github.com/dautovri/agentprof#readme

## Commands
- `agentprof scan`: Everything in one pass, a health score and recommendations.
- `agentprof report [--markdown] [--fail-under N] [--fail-on-secrets] [--repo-only] [--sarif FILE]`:
  0-100 health score over five categories. Unmeasured categories are left out.
  `--repo-only` scores only repository contents so CI results do not depend on
  the runner. `--sarif` writes findings for GitHub code scanning.
- `agentprof fix [--dry-run]`: Merges Read(...) deny rules for secret files into
  .claude/settings.json (Claude Code does not read .claudeignore) and a managed
  block into .cursorignore, keeping backups. `--shell` installs an opt-in guard
  that activates only when AGENTPROF_FAST_PATH=1.
- `agentprof context`: Instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules,
  .cursor/rules, .cursorrules, .windsurfrules, .windsurf/rules,
  copilot-instructions.md, .github/instructions, GEMINI.md, .clinerules,
  CONVENTIONS.md, CODEX.md, GROK.md) with tokens and whether each loads every
  session or on demand. Honours .gitignore.
- `agentprof lint [--fail-on error|warning|never]`: Contradictions between
  instruction files (word-boundary matching; rejections such as "instead of X"
  are not prescriptions), vague rules, hedged absolutes, duplicates.
- `agentprof compile [--target claude,cursor,copilot] [--apply] [--dry-run] [--force]`:
  Moves language- and area-specific sections into path-scoped rules
  (.claude/rules with `paths`, .cursor/rules .mdc with `globs`,
  .github/instructions with `applyTo`).
- `agentprof mcp [--probe] [--trust-workspace]`: MCP servers per agent from
  Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, OpenCode, Codex (config.toml),
  Gemini CLI and Windsurf configs. `--probe` performs a real initialize ->
  tools/list handshake. Servers defined inside the workspace are only started
  with `--trust-workspace`. Claude Code defers tool definitions (tool search),
  so only tool names count toward its per-turn load unless ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH
  says otherwise.
- `agentprof skills`: Always-loaded skill metadata tokens, on-invocation size,
  SKILL.md files over 500 lines, missing descriptions, trigger collisions.
- `agentprof history [--sessions N]`: Claude Code transcript usage, de-duplicated
  by message and request id, priced per model (API-equivalent cost).
- `agentprof bench [--iterations N]`: Median spawn time for bare, login and
  interactive shells, plus Claude Code's shell-snapshot replay.
- `agentprof omz`: Oh My Zsh startup and per-plugin cost.
- `agentprof agent`: Per-agent summary for Claude Code, OpenCode and Grok.
- `agentprof tui`: Interactive dashboard. Requires a real terminal.
- `agentprof wrap <cmd>`: Runs an agent with AGENTPROF_FAST_PATH=1 exported and
  propagates its exit code.
- `agentprof ci [--min-score N] [--force]`: Writes a workflow that uses the
  agentprof GitHub Action. Never overwrites without --force.
- `agentprof compress <file> [--overwrite]`: Removes conversational filler.
- `agentprof completions <shell>`: zsh, bash, fish, elvish or powershell.

## Global flags
- `--json`: Machine-readable output on stdout, with no human-facing banners.
- `--path <DIR>` or a positional path: target directory.

## Cost model
Anthropic list prices per model (for example Claude Sonnet 5 at $2/$10 per
million input/output tokens, Claude Opus 4.5-4.8 and Opus 5 at $5/$25).
5-minute cache writes bill at 1.25x input, 1-hour writes at 2x, cache reads at
the model's rate (0.1x for most models). Fixed-context estimates assume the
prefix is cached: one write plus 99 reads per 100 turns.
